purpose: Complete remaining real API contract probes after C01 and dedicated-origin setup. This document does not authorize ERP writes.

customer.source: Exact fiscal identity and address from the company configured in this same ERP account, privately captured and matched to C01 account document
customer.absenceProof: Both formatted and normalized document searches, explicit A/B/I/E situations, complete pagination, exact local document match. Reuse one A/B match unchanged; stop on I/E, duplicates, incomplete search or mismatch.
customer.creationPayloadBinding: Private exact fiscal source. No generated CPF, email, phone or access credentials.

payload.descricao: CAMISA PV PERSONALIZADA - PROVA CRM F1

parent.source: Unit, origin and NCM read from the existing CAMISA PV PERSONALIZADA M; catalog zero is a proposed explicit test-only price, requiring PO approval.
parent.stock: Omit initial stock, balance and stock commands; no channel listing or sync.

orders.purpose: Four decimal places, thirds, new origin and searchable reference
Ties, repeated same product with different values, M in two distinct parents
Six decimal places and large quantity

orderBinding.idContato: confirmed exact account-company customer, created or reused

ecommerce.id: private dedicated-origin integrator ID candidate; its API-v3 mapping remains unproved

orderBinding.optionalMoneyOrCommands: Omit freight, expenses, discounts, installments, integrated payment, fiscal/stock/financial/shipping/message commands.
orderBinding.existingRecords: C01 and existing buyer/catalog remain untouched.

verification.decimalLexemes: Preserve request/response numeric source lexemes; do not infer precision from displayed two-decimal units.
verification.lineSubtotals: Independently read each native ERP UI line subtotal because item GET does not expose a separate subtotal. Global total alone is insufficient.
verification.rounding: All expected line cents are diagnostic half-up hypotheses, not an asserted ERP rule.
verification.reference: After C02, GET by reference and known ID must identify exactly the same order/origin/customer/items. Stop subsequent orders if missing or ambiguous.
verification.recovery: Reserve each effect and dependent resource before POST in durable private journal; persist confirmed remote IDs before advancing. Never retry an uncertain or rejected POST, edit, cancel or delete for cleanup.
verification.readOnlyRejections: One unauthenticated GET /info to observe authentication rejection; bounded invalid filtered GET may inspect validation. No malformed or duplicate creation for testing.

stopConditions: Any identity, fiscal-source or catalog-price discrepancy before a write
Unknown outcome, invalid success response, absent ID, partial parent/variation mismatch
Unexpected charge, credential generation, extra scope, auto stock/finance/fiscal/channel action
C02 reference/origin not preserved or incomplete/ambiguous reconciliation
Any need to change approved payload, add an order or correct a saved record
effectsNotice: All created customers, parent/three variations and up to three orders remain in the operational ERP/reports. The 1000-unit case can affect quantity reports even at low value. Orders consume real sequential numbers. No cancellation/deletion as cleanup.
